nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfer senders, allowance spenders, and mint gating.
owner: privileged address set to deployer; gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
balanceOf: public mapping of holder balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
allowance: public nested approval mapping, decremented unchecked in transferFrom and written by approve.
canSale: whitelist mapping set true by _mints that bypasses all ensure() sale conditions.
tradeAddress: address whitelisted in ensure(), set by owner through setTradeAddress.
_onSaleNum: per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared to _saleNum in condition.
_saleNum: maximum number of sales allowed per address, written by init.
_minSale: minimum sale amount in scaled token units, written by init.
_maxSale: maximum sale amount in scaled token units, written by init.
totalSupply: token supply minted to deployer in constructor and never reduced in this contract.
UNI: hardcoded router address whitelisted inside ensure().
decimals: constant 18 used to scale _mints, init and constructor amounts.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable: allowance check, ensure() gate, then unchecked balance/allowance mutation.
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view: whitelist (owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress, canSale) otherwise delegates to condition().
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance reset.
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to untrusted contract.
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public: overwrites any balance and grants canSale whitelist for owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public: owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable: owner-only loop with unchecked multiplication and balance mutations.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure: computes the Uniswap pair address with an hardcoded init code hash.
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable: sets metadata, owner, totalSupply, deployer balance and infinite router allowance.
delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with attacker-supplied calldata b: full storage and context takeover, arbitrary value/destruction.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath protection.
Unchecked subtraction of balances (balanceOf[x] -= value) without SafeMath.
Unchecked addition of balances (balanceOf[x] += value) without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Privileged unconditional overwrite balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*10**decimals plus canSale grant; no supply cap and a hardcoded backdoor address.
